CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Account.ShippingCountry = "USA", Account.ShippingCountry = "US", Account.ShippingCountry = "United States", Account.ShippingCountry = "Canada", Account.ShippingCountry = "CA", Account.ShippingCountry = "Mexico" ), "AMER", IF( OR( Account.ShippingCountry = "United Kingdom", Account.ShippingCountry = "UK", Account.ShippingCountry = "Germany", Account.ShippingCountry = "France", Account.ShippingCountry = "Spain", Account.ShippingCountry = "Italy" /* Add other EMEA countries here */ ), "EMEA", "Other" ) )
